protocol_amendments.reason: avoid redundant computation for structurally identical preregistered arms without changing examples, arm labels, predictions, controller records, paired units, or inference claims
protocol_amendments.reporting: retain one record per arm and conversation; mark executed versus reused-exact-config and report physical forward counts separately from arm-conversation counts

execution_prerequisite: strict chain: P2 core has 4500 validated shards -> calibration-only physical hot-memory matching for every seed/scale -> exact equivalence for every seed/scale -> held-out causal factorial
one_x_action: run identity/equivalence audit only because calibrated quotas are preregistered uniform at 1x

fixed-top-p-0.5.signals: current-layer top-p cardinality only; uncertainty extras disabled
fixed-top-p-0.5.memory_claim: realized hot memory is measured and reported; equality to fixed top-k is not assumed

fixed-top-p-0.8.signals: current-layer top-p cardinality only; uncertainty extras disabled

offline_oracle_upper_bound.selection: maximum conversation accuracy using held-out targets
offline_oracle_upper_bound.leakage_rule: never used for calibration, arm selection, memory matching, or the primary causal gate

shuffle_rule.algorithm: cyclically rotate calibrated quota values over sorted eligible layer ids
shuffle_rule.collision_action: scan remaining non-zero offsets for the first changed mapping
shuffle_rule.uniform_quota_action: retain the identical mapping and label the cell structurally-identical; do not count it as layer-identity evidence

memory_matching.metric: mean measured hot_resident_bytes on the sequential physical-tier path
memory_matching.fixed_initial_match: mix uniform floor-k and ceil-k batches with a Bresenham schedule so mean configured blocks equal the calibrated quota total
memory_matching.fixed_mixture_unit: paired evaluation batch; fixed and fixed+pins use the identical schedule
memory_matching.physical_tier_capacity_rule: each CSA layer receives its own logical quota times batch size; no max-layer over-allocation
memory_matching.held_out_verification: repeat physical measurement on all evaluated conversations
memory_matching.failure_action: retune the fixed low/high mixture on calibration physical traces; if held-out bytes still miss 1 percent, withhold the central causal claim for that budget/scale cell

calibration_protocol.candidate_rule: uniform floor/ceil k; when the configured total is divisible, also measure adjacent k-1 and k+1
calibration_protocol.required_cells: both budgets at all 5 seeds and both scales

execution.quality_path_requirement: each factorial arm must pass exact sequential physical-tier prediction equivalence before chunked quality execution

equivalence_validation.seed_rule: validate every frozen checkpoint because calibrated quota and physical-match schedules can differ by seed
equivalence_validation.arms: all 10 primary, 2 fixed-top-p baseline, and 4 component arms

execution.execution_order: deterministic rotation of all arms within every paired batch

exact_config_reuse.identity: canonical SHA-256 of the complete SameTokenControllerConfig plus exact dataclass equality
exact_config_reuse.timing_accounting: reused arms record zero executed wall time and name the source arm
exact_config_reuse.statistical_unit: unchanged paired conversation; reused arm labels are not presented as independent inference executions

statistics.primary_inference: resample the five independent training-seed means; conversation-paired intervals are descriptive within seed
statistics.primary_four_cell_correction: Bonferroni over the 2 scales x 2 required budget cells using the five independent training-seed means as bootstrap clusters
statistics.family_correction: Holm-Bonferroni over the 9 families separately within each contrast, scale, and budget
statistics.contrast_correction: Holm-Bonferroni over all 12 preregistered contrasts separately within each scale and budget

central_gate.pooled_effect: strictly positive at every required budget and both scales
central_gate.corrected_cluster_bootstrap_lower_bound: 98.75 percent training-seed-cluster bootstrap lower bound is strictly positive in each of the four 2-scale x 2-budget primary cells
central_gate.seed_effects: all five strictly positive at each required budget and scale
central_gate.memory_match: within 1 percent at every required budget and scale
